description: Captures a playing <video>/<audio> element in the active tab via captureStream() and sends chunks to your own local Whisper server. No cloud, no minute limit. Firefox has no tabCapture API, so this is NOT a 1:1 port of the Chrome version — it only works on pages with a real HTML5 media element (YouTube, etc.), not arbitrary tab audio.
name: Tab Whisper — Local Tab Audio to Whisper (Firefox)
